calls.statement:
SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, s.store_id=999 AS is_train,
  count(*) AS lines, count(distinct r.return_line_id) AS distinct_ids, count(distinct r.sales_line_id) AS distinct_sales_lines,
  sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units, min(r.return_date) mn, max(r.return_date) mx
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND (cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' OR p.subcategory='Garden Furniture')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
SELECT r.reason_code, count(*) lines, sum(r.quantity_returned) units, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net,
  min(r.quantity_returned) minq, max(r.quantity_returned) maxq,
  sum((CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> r.return_date)::int) AS date_mismatch,
  sum((r.quantity_returned > f.quantity)::int) AS over_returned,
  sum((r.refund_net <= 0)::int) AS nonpos_refund,
  sum((r.return_date < f.sale_date)::int) AS before_sale
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period, 'Garden' AS category, 'Garden Furniture' AS subcategory,
       SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned,
       SUM((p.subcategory='Garden Furniture')::int * r.quantity_returned) AS units_as_was
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1, 2
